title: Online Trove of Natural History Images
content: From Tortoises, terrapins, and turtles,London, Paris, and Frankfort :H. Sotheran, J. Baer & co.,1872.Biodiversity Heritage Libraryis a free, online archive of more than 150,000 high resolution science-based renderings of insects, birds, flowers, and shells. You can scan through a vast collection of natural history artwork of fauna and flora, mostly created before the era of photography.------Biodiversity Heritage LibraryonFlickrSmithsonian Magazine: "You Can Now Download 150,000 Free Illustrations of the Natural World"
